items_flat.title_en: Google releases Gemini 3.7 Flash, its most intelligent workhorse model for coding and agents
items_flat.title_zh: Google 發布 Gemini 3.7 Flash：迄今最強 coding 與 agents 工作馬模型
items_flat.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash on August 13 as the most intelligent model in its Flash series for coding, knowledge work and agents. It delivers substantial gains over 3.6 Flash on coding benchmarks (FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%, DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49%) and web development, with introductory pricing at half the previous rate ($0.75/$3.75 per 1M tokens through end-2026). Available now in the Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemini Spark for Pro/Ultra users and enterprise platforms.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 8 月 13 日宣布 Gemini 3.7 Flash，定位為 Flash 系列中最智能的 coding、知識工作與 agents 工作馬模型。相較 3.6 Flash，在 coding 基準大幅進步（FrontierCode 43.6% vs 34.4%、DeepSWE 65.3% vs 49%），並提供半價導入價（$0.75/$3.75 每百萬 tokens，至 2026 年底）。現已在 Gemini API、AI Studio、Pro/Ultra 的 Spark 與企業平台上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: The three-week follow-up to 3.6 Flash plus aggressive intro pricing shows Google prioritising rapid iteration and cost-performance in the agentic workhorse segment. Key uncertainty is whether the gains hold against higher-tier rivals once the discount ends in 2027.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 僅隔三週再推 3.7 並祭出半價，顯示 Google 急於以性價比搶攻 agentic coding 市場。關鍵不確定性在於 2027 年定價恢復後，優勢能否持續對標更高階模型。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們在廣受使用的 Flash 系列基礎上，推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，這是目前最適合 coding 與 agents 的最強工作馬模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14× the speed via Cerebras
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 Ultrafast 模式：GPT-5.6 Sol 透過 Cerebras 最高加速 14 倍
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Ultrafast, a new API tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× faster than standard processing and generates up to 750 output tokens per second, powered by Cerebras. The limited preview is available today to a select group of customers for time-sensitive workflows such as incident response, financial research and customer support. Sign-up for updates is open as capacity expands.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 Ultrafast 新 API 層級，讓 GPT-5.6 Sol 較標準處理最高加速 14 倍，並可達每秒 750 個 output tokens，由 Cerebras 驅動。目前以 limited preview 形式提供給精選客戶，適用於事故回應、金融研究與客服等時效性工作流。容量擴大後將逐步開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: Pairing frontier intelligence with extreme speed removes a key barrier for real-time agentic and interactive applications. Uncertainty centres on when (and at what price) Ultrafast moves beyond limited preview.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿智能與極高速度結合，移除了即時 agents 與互動應用的關鍵瓶頸。不確定性在於 Ultrafast 何時（以及以何價格）走出 limited preview。
items_flat.quote: Until now, getting real-time speed typically meant choosing a smaller or more specialized model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 直到現在，要獲得即時速度通常意味著必須選擇較小或更專門的模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Computer History in ChatGPT desktop app for Mac
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Mac 桌面版推出 Computer History 功能
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI released Computer History, an opt-in feature in the ChatGPT desktop app on macOS that records interaction events across selected apps and websites (not screenshots) to build a searchable timeline and memories. It replaces the Chronicle research preview with lower token usage and stronger privacy controls, rolling out now to Pro, Business and Enterprise users (EEA/UK/Switzerland later).
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Mac 桌面版推出選用功能 Computer History，透過互動事件（非螢幕截圖）記錄選定 app 與網站活動，建立可搜尋時間軸與記憶。此功能取代 Chronicle 研究預覽，降低 token 用量並強化隱私控制，目前先對 Pro、Business、Enterprise 用戶開放（EEA/UK/瑞士稍後跟進）。
items_flat.analysis_en: Giving the model persistent, user-controlled context from the local desktop moves ChatGPT closer to a true personal agent. Privacy design and opt-in nature will determine real-world adoption and regulatory comfort.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 讓模型擁有使用者可控的本地桌面持久上下文，讓 ChatGPT 更接近真正個人 agents。隱私設計與選用機制將決定實際採用率與監管接受度。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT can now remember your activity across the apps and websites on your computer.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT 現在可以記住你在電腦上各個 app 與網站的活動。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic updates Claude Tag to read more of the room with ~30% better proactive decisions
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 更新 Claude Tag：更懂場合，主動決策改善約 30%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic released an update to Claude Tag (its Slack agent) that lets Claude use full channel context, memory and standing instructions to decide when and how to contribute. The model now chooses among four moves—reply inline, start a thread, route to in-flight work, or stay silent—improving proactive decisions by roughly 30%. Available at no extra cost for Teams and Enterprise customers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 更新 Claude Tag（其 Slack agent），讓 Claude 能運用完整頻道上下文、記憶與常駐指示決定何時與如何介入。模型現可在四種行動中選擇——直接回覆、開 thread、轉給進行中工作流，或保持沉默——主動決策改善約 30%。Teams 與 Enterprise 客戶無額外費用即可使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving from a simple classifier to richer context-aware behaviour makes Claude more useful as a collaborative agent rather than a reactive bot. Real-world value will depend on how well the new silence/usefulness rubric works across noisy enterprise channels.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 從簡單分類器升級為能讀場合的上下文感知行為，讓 Claude 更像協作 agents 而非被動機器人。實際價值取決於新「沉默／有用性」準則在嘈雜企業頻道中的表現。
items_flat.quote: Claude now uses context from across the Slack channel, along with its memory and standing instructions, to determine when to contribute proactively.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 現在會運用整個 Slack 頻道的上下文，加上記憶與常駐指示，來決定何時主動貢獻。

brief_en: Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash with strong coding/agent gains and half-price intro rates. OpenAI previewed Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol (up to 14× speed via Cerebras) and rolled out Computer History for Mac desktop ChatGPT. Anthropic improved Claude Tag proactive responses ~30%. Quiet day overall; no major Meta or xAI moves in the window.
brief_zh: Google 推出 Gemini 3.7 Flash，coding 與 agents 大幅提升並祭出半價導入。OpenAI 預覽 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 Ultrafast 模式（Cerebras 加速最高 14 倍）並上線 Mac 版 ChatGPT 的 Computer History 功能。Anthropic 改進 Claude Tag 主動回應約 30%。整體平靜，Meta 與 xAI 無重大新動態。
